name: Peacemakers
overview: Scripture calls believers to embody the role of peacemakers, promising that those who pursue peace will be recognized as children of God. This calling involves living peaceably with others as far as it depends on us, reflecting Christ’s own peace that surpasses worldly understanding. Jesus teaches that anger and contempt toward others endanger our standing before God, while the Golden Rule commands us to treat others as we wish to be treated, fostering harmony and reconciliation. True peacemaking flows from a heart aligned with Christ’s peace, free from fear and trouble.
